title: Cadence Device→Brain Event Envelope
$comment: Wire contract for POST /ingest/event. Field-for-field aligned with cadence.adapters.base.Event (source of truth: cadence/adapters/base.py). Structured-only: carries provenance POINTERS (raw_evidence_ref/payload_hash) and a bounded non-verbatim summary, never verbatim raw content (message/email/chat/audio/screenshot text). additionalProperties=false mirrors Event's model_config extra='forbid'. A future breaking revision bumps both the trailing path segment of $id and schema_version together.
description: A single normalized, provenance-tagged event a device agent sends to the brain's ingest endpoint. Devices construct exactly one envelope per captured item; verbatim raw evidence never leaves the device except to the device-local/NAS evidence store referenced by raw_evidence_ref.

event_id.description: Stable id of the source event, opaque to the brain (e.g. a provider message id or a device-local capture id).

source.description: Provider name, e.g. 'github', 'google_calendar', 'gmail', or a device-agent source like 'android_notification', 'windows_active_window'.

account_ref.description: Opaque per-account reference. NEVER a credential, token, or email address body — an opaque handle the brain's credential vault understands.

acquisition_tier.description: How the data was acquired — drives trust/compliance handling downstream. Device agents typically send 'notification_wal' (NotificationListener WAL capture), 'scrape_nonroot' (idle-room accessibility scrape), or 'device_os_api' (direct on-device OS/system-API reads not otherwise categorized: app-usage, active-window, device telemetry, SMS provider, location).

occurred_at.description: When the source event actually happened, UTC ISO-8601. Null if unknown.

ingested_at.description: When this event was captured/ingested, UTC ISO-8601. Devices SHOULD omit this field and let the brain stamp receipt time; if set, it MUST be the device's own UTC capture instant (never null — omit instead of sending null).

device_id.description: Originating device (a dedupe input and observability tag, not an auth credential).

dedupe_id.description: Cross-device idempotency key. A device MAY set this itself (e.g. its own WAL content hash); if omitted, the brain derives sha256('{source}|{account_ref}|{event_id}') and dedupes on that instead.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw payload (the bytes referenced by raw_evidence_ref), for integrity verification. Never the payload itself.

raw_evidence_ref.description: Opaque NAS blob id/hash for the verbatim raw evidence, if any was retained. Points at device-local/NAS storage — never a value the brain resolves to raw content itself.

summary.description: Short, NON-verbatim summary (e.g. 'notification from Messages app'). MUST NOT contain verbatim message/email/chat/transcript text; the brain's raw-boundary classifier independently rejects overlong or content-flagged summaries at write time.

confidence.description: Optional confidence score for this observation, if the adapter/device computes one.

structured.description: Normalized, structured fields for this event (D1-projection inputs, e.g. 'due_at', 'title', 'actionable'). Convention-based per source/kind — see cadence.brain.projection. MUST NOT carry verbatim raw content; keys matching raw-content names (raw, body, text, content, message, email, chat, transcript, audio, voice, screenshot, ocr, attachment, photo, image, account_number, card_number, ssn, password, secret, token, credential) are structurally rejected here and independently by the brain's raw-boundary classifier.
